name: claude-quenching
description: Marketplace hosting the claude-quenching plugin: an OKF-centric knowledge-base aligner, inserter, knowledge-capturer, glossary-curator, memory-to-docs migrator, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md harness-refactorer, external-source importer, offline HTML diagram renderer, and run-to-convergence cycle for the Claude Code surface of any repository.

plugins.name: claude-quenching
plugins.description: Forces any repository's docs/ knowledge base into a single canonical Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) bundle and keeps it conformant. Ten skills — align (structure), insert (any doc), knowledge (concepts), glossary + knowledge-scan (the fixed A–Z term lookup), memory-to-docs (drain project memory), harness (thin CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md pointers), enrich (import external sources), visualize (offline HTML diagram), cycle (run everything to convergence) — plus a self-contained enforcement hook and a zero-dependency diagram generator. The routing story lives in each skill's own description. Every repository that adopts it looks the same.
